$schema_note: Reference only — apply equivalent Cache Rules in the Cloudflare dashboard (or API). Not consumed by Wrangler/Pages.

rules.name: WooCommerce and WP admin — bypass cache
rules.description: Never cache cart, checkout, account, admin, login, wc-ajax, wc-api (Whop webhook), or sessions with WP/Woo cookies.
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cart")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/checkout")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/my-account")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-admin")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-login.php")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-json/")) or (http.request.uri.query contains "wc-ajax=") or (http.request.uri.query contains "wc-api=") or (http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_") or (http.cookie contains "woocommerce_items_in_cart")

rules.name: Static uploads and theme/plugin assets — long TTL
rules.description: Cache media and static CSS/JS/fonts/images under wp-content with a long edge TTL. Keep priority after bypass.
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-content/uploads/")) or ((starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-content/themes/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-content/plugins/")) and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".css") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".js") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".woff2") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".png") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jpg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jpeg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".webp") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".svg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".ico")))
rules.notes: 2592000 = 30 days edge; tune browser TTL as needed. Prefer Ignore origin cache-control if Railway sends no-cache on static files.

waf_skip_challenges_note.name: Skip bot challenges on Whop webhook
waf_skip_challenges_note.why: Whop POSTs to /?wc-api=whop_webhook must reach WordPress without an HTML challenge interstitial.
